MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The J-B Weld epoxy fits the durable repair work suggested by my duct tape and vinyl cement purchases, and a two-pack feels manageable.",
    "The caliper has a concrete use alongside my hose clamps: measuring hose and fitting diameters so I can choose the right size."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The tabletop resin is an adhesive-related product, but decorative surface coating serves a different purpose from the functional repairs I want to make.",
    "Magnets, casters, specific screws, and an angle gauge need particular projects to be useful to me; buying repair supplies or a handtruck does not mean I currently need those parts.",
    "Super glue fits my repair interests, but ten tubes exceed what I would choose now, and I have no current use for twelve wastebaskets or a jewelry cleaner."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in anything useful around a workshop, even when the item has no clear connection to my current repair needs.",
    "My earlier bulk tape purchase seems to have been taken as a preference for large quantities generally, although the amount I need depends on the particular supply."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated hose clamp purchases make practical fit and diameter measurement more relevant to me than unrelated precision tools.",
    "I care about the job an item solves: repairing a bond, coating a tabletop, and mounting something are different needs even if the products all sound suitable for DIY work.",
    "Compatibility and quantity matter: a useful type of supply can still be the wrong choice when its dimensions or pack size do not suit my task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into unrelated projects and quantities I do not currently need."
}
